span.p:
Key mapping: hash(key) mod 2^32 → nearest vnode clockwise
Key "user:123" → hash = 0x7A3F → vnode A2 → physical node A
Key "post:456" → hash = 0x2B1C → vnode B1 → physical node B
Key "feed:789" → hash = 0xE4D8 → vnode C1 → physical node C
